name: nat-fork-recovery-metadata-only-receipts
description: native-host.ts:680 fork notes recover metadata-only nested writes through edited receipts and compaction: a codemode call writes a note whose body is over the per-call argument limit, its receipt is context-edited, a large local result triggers automatic rollover whose recovery handoff says the full content is not retained, a fork copies the written note, and once the receipt is explicitly omitted (context_edit null) a fork no longer seeds it. (The edits are appended to the session file by the harness command /eq-ctxedit and the session is reloaded: RPC cannot call SessionManager.appendContextEdit.)

arguments.code: await tools.notes({op:"write", path:"metadata-only.md", content:"saved checkpoint ".repeat(1024)}); return "Saved";

rpc.message: /eq-ctxedit codemode Edited receipt without note content.
Read the note in the fork.
List the notes in the second fork.
